greeting.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
text: Mind the beam. Beds are up the stair, ale is down here, and trouble goes back out the door it came in by.
Wipe the road off before you sit on my settle. Beds up, drink down, trouble outside.
You'll want the far bench. The near one's got a leg that argues, and so has the man on it.

options.text: A bed for the party. What does that cost?
Who's been drinking here that shouldn't be?
How long have you had this place?
Two silver for whatever the house is pouring.
Nothing. We're only out of the rain.

again.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
text: Back, and still upright. That's better than half my regulars manage.
You again. The beam hasn't moved, in case you were hoping.
I kept the far bench clear. Don't make me regret the sentiment.

options.text: Anything said about us in here?
Who's been drinking here that shouldn't be?
A round for the room, on us.

beds.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
beds.text: Forty for the room, and I'll not charge you for the snoring. Come back when you've slept somewhere worse.

the_quiet_table.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
the_quiet_table.text: The table by the shutter. Three of them, paying in coin that was minted a long way east of here. They ask about the pass, never about the road home.

nothing_doing.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
nothing_doing.text: Farmers and their sons, same as every night. Drink or don't.

poured.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
poured.text: Sit where you like. You're the first company all week that came in wearing its own blood instead of somebody else's.

the_house.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
the_house.text: My father's, and his before that. Three generations of listening to other people's plans and never once being asked along.

said_of_you.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
text: Plenty. None of it agrees with the rest, which is how I know some of it's true.
A carter had a version where there were nine of you and one was on fire. I told him the beam was more interesting.
Enough that men stop talking when you come in. Enjoy it while it's still respect.

the_round.speaker: Bole the Innkeep
the_round.text: That'll be remembered longer than whatever you do with a sword. Sit down before they start thanking you.
